questions.passage:
Checking Product Barcodes

Two board ranges, two different uses

Our S-grade and D-grade boards share the same dimensions: 20 millimetres thick, 100 millimetres wide, and 2 metres long. The size is identical, but the grades are not interchangeable.

S-grade boards are tested for load-bearing applications. Choose this range when the board will form part of a supporting frame. They have a plain, unfinished surface so builders can apply the finish their project requires.

documents.title: Understanding the indexed service price
documents.text:
MILLSTREAM CLEANING — Contract Price Guide

Our annual price adjustment follows the published labour-cost index named in your contract. It changes the price of the existing cleaning schedule; it does not add rooms, visits or specialist services. We show the index calculation on the renewal statement so customers can compare the same service before and after adjustment.

Optional additions are quoted separately. For example, a customer currently paying $500 a month may receive a 4 percent index adjustment, making the same service $520. Adding a monthly carpet treatment priced at $60 would bring the total to $580, but only if the customer accepts that additional work.

A statement showing $520 does not mean carpet treatment is included. Equally, declining the treatment does not remove the $20 indexed change to the existing schedule. documents.text:
FENWAY SUPPLIES — Dispatch Desk Notice

Three documents accompany each completed order, but they serve different purposes. Put the delivery note in the clear pouch on the outside of the goods. It lists item codes and quantities without prices, allowing the receiving team to check the shipment. Email the invoice directly to the customer's accounts address; do not put it in that pouch. Accounts staff need the prices and payment reference, while warehouse staff do not need access to those details.

Keep a signed collection record at our dispatch desk. A carrier's signature on that record proves which cartons left our premises. It does not prove that the customer later received every item. If a customer reports a shortage, compare its checked delivery note with our collection record before adjusting stock. An unsigned office copy of the invoice cannot establish the quantities actually received.

For mixed orders, use a separate delivery note for each destination even when there is one combined invoice. Label each pouch with its destination code. Staff must never assume that a combined bill means all cartons are travelling to one location; the routing list, not the billing total, determines where each carton goes.

documents.title: Community survey tender requirements
documents.text:
CIVIC RESEARCH — Tender Webpage

Every bid must include a sampling plan, an anonymised raw-data file in CSV format, a written findings report, and a two-hour staff training session. These are mandatory deliverables. A dashboard is optional: it may make results easier to explore, but cannot replace either the raw-data file or the written report.

Training must be accessible to staff using screen readers. A demonstration of an inaccessible dashboard does not satisfy this condition, even if a written report is accessible. Bidders may use their preferred analysis software, provided the CSV export opens without a paid software licence. Do not remove a required deliverable merely to stay below a proposed price. Show any optional work separately so assessors can compare complete core bids.

Survey participants' names and contact details must not appear in the delivered CSV. Keep only anonymous respondent codes that allow answers from the same person to be linked.

documents.title: Proposed bid revision
documents.text:
To: Delivery Team
From: Talia Neri, Bid Manager

Our present proposal includes the sampling plan, written report and a dashboard, with a one-hour dashboard demonstration instead of staff training. It promises a spreadsheet file that can be opened only in our paid analysis application. We planned to remove the raw export to keep the price within our estimate.

Please revise the core offer rather than ask Civic Research to treat those omissions as optional. We can drop the dashboard to free resources. Our trainer can deliver two hours of screen-reader-compatible instruction using the report and an ordinary CSV reader. Check that the revised data file preserves linked answers without exposing personal contacts.

Dataset: Current draft contains respondent code, name, email and answers

Reviewer instruction: Assess the changed core offer against every mandatory requirement. Removing the dashboard solves no data-format or privacy defect by itself. Keep anonymous codes when deleting contact columns, so answers remain connected to the same respondent.

documents.text:
CIVIC RESEARCH — Tender Webpage

Every bid must include a sampling plan, an anonymised raw-data file in CSV format, a written findings report, and a two-hour staff training session. These are mandatory deliverables. A dashboard is optional: it may make results easier to explore, but cannot replace either the raw-data file or the written report.

Training must be accessible to staff using screen readers. A demonstration of an inaccessible dashboard does not satisfy this condition, even if a written report is accessible. Bidders may use their preferred analysis software, provided the CSV export opens without a paid software licence. Do not remove a required deliverable merely to stay below a proposed price. Show any optional work separately so assessors can compare complete core bids.

Survey participants' names and contact details must not appear in the delivered CSV. Keep only anonymous respondent codes that allow answers from the same person to be linked.
